art_direction: AI-флорист Марина для маркетплейса Flowwow: кремово-сливовая палитра с тёплым песочным фоном и глубоким сливовым акцентом, живой цветочный мотив (бутон-лаунчер + лепестковые bubble-уголки), дружелюбная системная типографика. Бутон раскрывается в мягкий скруглённый panel без стеклянного blur и без дешёвого градиента — тёплая заливка. Лепестковые углы у assistant-сообщений слева, каплевидные — у user справа. Минимум: система не безликa.

javascript: (function(){"use strict";function init(){const root=document.querySelector('.kaigo-widget');if(!root)return;const panel=root.querySelector('[data-region="panel"]');const launcher=root.querySelector('[data-region="launcher"] [data-action="open"], .kaigo-widget__launcher');const input=root.querySelector('#kaigo-composer-input');const sendBtn=root.querySelector('[data-action="send"]');const closeBtn=root.querySelector('[data-action="close"]');const suggestions=root.querySelectorAll('[data-action="suggestion"]');const messages=root.querySelector('[data-region="messages"]');let openedOnce=false;function isOpen(){return root.classList.contains('kaigo-preview-open')||root.getAttribute('data-state')==='open'||panel.hasAttribute('data-open');}function triggerLauncher(){const btn=launcher&&launcher.querySelector?launcher.querySelector('[data-action="open"]'):null;if(btn&&typeof btn.click==='function'){btn.click();}else if(launcher&&typeof launcher.click==='function'){launcher.click();}}function triggerClose(){if(closeBtn&&typeof closeBtn.click==='function')closeBtn.click();}function triggerSend(text){if(!sendBtn)return;if(input){input.value=text;input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}sendBtn.click();}function attachOpenOnce(){if(openedOnce)return;openedOnce=true;setTimeout(function(){triggerLauncher();},2200);}if(window.IntersectionObserver){const io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){entries.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting&&e.intersectionRatio>0.25){attachOpenOnce();io.disconnect();}});},{threshold:[0.25]});io.observe(root);}else{setTimeout(function(){attachOpenOnce();},2600);}function bumpDraft(){if(!input)return;if(input.scrollHeight>input.clientHeight&&input.scrollHeight<100){input.style.height='auto';input.style.height=Math.min(input.scrollHeight,100)+'px';}}if(input){input.addEventListener('input',bumpDraft);input.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();if(input.value.trim().length>0){triggerSend(input.value);}}});}if(suggestions&&suggestions.length){suggestions.forEach(function(s){s.addEventListener('click',function(){var txt=s.getAttribute('data-kaigo-suggestion')||s.textContent.trim();triggerSend(txt);});});}if(closeBtn){closeBtn.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();closeBtn.click();}});}if(sendBtn){sendBtn.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();if(input&&input.value.trim().length>0)sendBtn.click();}});}if(launcher){launcher.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&!isOpen()){e.preventDefault();triggerLauncher();}});}}function domReady(fn){if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fn);}else{fn();}}var attempts=0;function boot(){attempts++;var root=document.querySelector('.kaigo-widget');if(!root&&attempts<30){setTimeout(boot,100);return;}if(root){try{init();}catch(e){}}}domReady(boot);})();

layout_contract.root_position: fixed; bottom-right corner; pointer-events none on container, auto on launcher/panel
layout_contract.launcher_position: bottom:22px right:22px desktop; bottom:16px right:16px mobile; compact, fully visible
layout_contract.panel_width: desktop 376px (within 320-440 recommended range); mobile full width minus 32px margins (left/right 16px)
layout_contract.panel_height: desktop max-height calc(100vh - 44px); mobile max-height 70vh (within 64-78% range); 74vh at <=390px
layout_contract.panel_position: desktop absolute bottom:22px right:22px (fits viewport, no fullscreen); mobile bottom sheet full width, top rounded corners
layout_contract.open_animation: opacity 0.45s + translateY 28px + scale 0.92 to 1, origin bottom-right, 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.2,0.64,1); launcher scales to 0.2 and fades
layout_contract.close_animation: reverse of open; launcher scales back to 1
layout_contract.messages_overflow: scrollHeight<=clientHeight on first open (one welcome message, two suggestions); scroll allowed after runtime adds turns
layout_contract.message_max_width: assistant 88% left; user 82% right; distinct asymmetric bubble corners (petal vs drop)
layout_contract.suggestions: two quick replies, wrap flex; hidden after first user message via :has(); hidden during error
layout_contract.composer: textarea rows=1 auto-grow to max 100px; send button 44x44px; Enter to send, Shift+Enter newline
layout_contract.interactive_targets: close 44x44, send 44x44, suggestion min 44x44, retry min 44x44 — all meet minimum
layout_contract.auto_open: javascript opens panel after 2.2s via existing launcher control (IntersectionObserver or timeout fallback); stops permanently after first interaction
layout_contract.attention_cue: launcher pulse ring + flower breathe on .kaigo-preview-attention; CSS-only, runtime-owned timer
layout_contract.reduced_motion: ambient sway, pulse, breathe, blink all disabled; state feedback (open/close/hover/active) preserved instantly
layout_contract.font_stack: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif (system fonts only)
